Title: Question on the correct way to play the tangle atropos hand

Messages.Author: 1muflon1
Messages.Body:
Hi guys, I would like to ask a clarifying question about Tangle Atropos' Hand card.

The card says that "cancel the action and untap the acting minion..." and so on...

Now does this mean that the minion can try to perform the same action on the same turn?

I know that there is a rule against performing/attempting the same action twice (for example like with freak drive). However, this card cancels the action. Also, the direct intervention out-of-turn master which also can cancel action cards has the following ruling:

"Ruling: Since the NRA rule is applied to the acting minion when the action resolves (is blocked or is successful), the minion whose action card is cancelled by Direct Intervention is free to attempt the same type of action again, even with (another copy of) the same card. [LSJ 19980212]."

So I personally think that it should be able to perform the same action again, but one friend from my local group disagrees.

It would be nice if someone could clear things up. Many thanks in advance!

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
The NRA rule is not triggered.
You are free to perform the same action again. Yes, Tangle is that good.

National Coordinator Germany  nc [dot] germany [at] magenta [dot] de

Messages.Author: Squidalot
Messages.Body: Yes, you're correct and your reference to that NRA ruling is correct it applies to Direct Intervention and Tangle in the same way for Actions. .

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Hakuron and Squidalot are correct. The important thing is that the action didn't reach resolution (blocked or successful).

Messages.Author: Lead
Messages.Body: So if Mylan (or that AUS card or Abdelsobek or so on) untags someone who has played Kiss of Ra, can they play a 2nd copy of an action card or bleed or vote again? Meaning, does that scenario follow the DI / Tangle pattern?

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
> Lead wrote:
> So if Mylan (or that AUS card or Abdelsobek or so on) untags someone who has played Kiss of Ra, can they play a 2nd copy of an action card or bleed or vote again? Meaning, does that scenario follow the DI / Tangle pattern?
>
No. Think your way through the sequence. Mylan untaps a tapped vampire. He does not have any text, anywhere, mentioning that the action was cancelled (not taken.) Any vampire he untaps may only take actions that do not have NRA taint.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Blooded wrote:
>
> > Lead wrote:
> > So if Mylan (or that AUS card or Abdelsobek or so on) untags someone who has played Kiss of Ra, can they play a 2nd copy of an action card or bleed or vote again? Meaning, does that scenario follow the DI / Tangle pattern?
> >
> No. Think your way through the sequence. Mylan untaps a tapped vampire. He does not have any text, anywhere, mentioning that the action was cancelled (not taken.) Any vampire he untaps may only take actions that do not have NRA taint.
>
Correct. Kiss of Ra doesn't cancel the action, it ends it. This implies that the action has reached resolution (unsuccessfully) and is tainted by the NRA.
